summary: Iteration 2 focused on 4 new features (Kiosk Student Tap, Wallet Top-Up, ESG Report Export, Lost Container Alerts) plus regression. Backend pytest: 34/34 passed (21 prior + 13 new). Frontend Playwright: verified kiosk student tap lists all 7 students and shows only issued containers per student; wallet top-up dialog on /app/wallet works (preset 100 → new balance & Topup row appears); admin Analytics 'Download ESG Report' successfully downloads ReLoop_ESG_Report_2026-09-12.csv; admin Alerts page loads via nav-alerts, lists 1 overdue container with Remind + Mark Lost actions; student Arjun sees notification banner with 2 reminder items and can dismiss.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console) — minor, not blocking

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the top-up dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_demo_extras() only guarantees ONE overdue container ever; if that seeded container is marked lost during testing/demo, the alerts page becomes empty until another Issued container ages 48h. Consider seeding based on presence count rather than a boolean flag, or reseeding when overdue list is empty.

overdue_alerts uses datetime.fromisoformat on issued_at strings — safe for the ISO strings produced by now_iso(), but any historical rows lacking timezone info would crash. Consider defensive parsing.
/api/notifications/{nid}/read does not verify the notification exists before returning success — silent no-op for wrong IDs. Low severity but worth returning 404.
server.py is now 870+ lines; splitting into routers (auth, containers, kiosk, wallet, alerts, analytics) recommended.
No idempotency on POST /api/alerts/remind — repeated clicks create duplicate notifications for the same overdue transaction. Consider upserting or 'created within last N minutes' check.
seed_data_creation: None manually created; relied on ensure_demo_extras() seeded ~96h overdue container. Test-created data uses TEST_ prefix / test_<uuid>@campus.edu email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints stable. Wallet top-up route is /api/wallet/topup body {amount}. Kiosk student-tap uses two public endpoints /api/kiosk/students and /api/kiosk/student-returns/{sid}. Alerts overdue seeded once via demo_overdue_seeded flag in settings — if that overdue txn gets closed/marked lost, /alerts/overdue will be empty until real overdue accrues. To re-seed for a fresh demo, clear settings.demo_overdue_seeded.
